$Comment: Guest of Honor: reach Exalted IV with Festival Favor (Festival_Tier_3), the highest of the ranks
Earned once and kept: Festival Favor carries from season to season and year to year, so this has no
Occurrence. REPUTATION_RANK credits every rank a player's favor has reached, the reputation's own
ranks above Exalted included, each time their favor changes and when they log in. Target is the rank
id and Qualifier the reputation id; the criterion's TextKey words the step with the rank's name.
Filed under Seasons with no subcategory, beside the ladder; it carries no season_keepsake tag, so
the ladder never counts it, and no Chains, so it is no rung. It pays the title
Seasons_Of_Orbis_Guest_Of_Honor through the Title reward kind, on unlock: a title is the one thing an
achievement pays without waiting to be collected.
